```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml)

# ---- Category + emoji mapping (11 groups) ----

CATEGORIES <- list(
    "Package Dev" = list(
        icon = "📦",
        prefixes = c(
            "r-init-package",
            "r-pkg-add-",
            "r-pkg-check",
            "r-pkg-release",
            "r-pkgcheck-",
            "r-pkgdown-",
            "r-pak-"
        )
    ),
    "Testing & QA" = list(
        icon = "🧪",
        prefixes = c(
            "r-lint",
            "r-tdd-",
            "r-bdd-",
            "r-testthat-",
            "r-code-review"
        )
    ),
    "Shiny Apps" = list(
        icon = "✨",
        prefixes = c(
            "r-init-shiny",
            "r-shiny-module",
            "r-shiny-theme-",
            "r-shiny-e2e-",
            "r-rhino-"
        )
    ),
    "Data Pipelines" = list(
        icon = "🎯",
        prefixes = c("r-init-targets", "r-targets-")
    ),
    "Deploy & DevOps" = list(
        icon = "🚀",
        prefixes = c("r-docker-", "r-connect-", "r-vetiver-", "r-ci-")
    ),
    "APIs" = list(
        icon = "🔌",
        prefixes = c("r-api-", "r-init-plumber")
    ),
    "Observability" = list(
        icon = "📊",
        prefixes = c("r-logger-", "r-otel-", "r-profile")
    ),
    "Data & Validation" = list(
        icon = "🛡️",
        prefixes = c("r-data-", "r-pointblank-")
    ),
    "Architecture" = list(
        icon = "🏗️",
        prefixes = c("r-box-", "r-s7-", "r-refactor", "r-async-")
    ),
    "Config & Security" = list(
        icon = "🔒",
        prefixes = c("r-config-", "r-security")
    ),
    "Reports" = list(
        icon = "📄",
        prefixes = c("r-quarto-")
    )
)

get_playbook_meta <- function(name) {
    for (cat_name in names(CATEGORIES)) {
        for (prefix in CATEGORIES[[cat_name]]$prefixes) {
            if (startsWith(name, prefix)) {
                return(c(CATEGORIES[[cat_name]]$icon, cat_name))
            }
        }
    }
    c("📋", "Other")
}

# ---- Read all playbooks ----

playbook_dirs <- list.dirs("playbooks", recursive = FALSE)
playbooks <- list()

for (dir in playbook_dirs) {
    md_file <- file.path(dir, "PLAYBOOK.md")
    if (!file.exists(md_file)) {
        next
    }

    content <- readLines(md_file, warn = FALSE)
    dashes <- which(content == "---")
    if (length(dashes) < 2) {
        next
    }

    yaml_text <- paste(
        content[(dashes[1] + 1):(dashes[2] - 1)],
        collapse = "\n"
    )

    # Use regex to extract just the 4 fields we need (robust to YAML quirks)
    get_yaml_field <- function(text, field) {
        m <- grep(
            sprintf("^\\s*%s:\\s*(\\S.*)$", field),
            text,
            value = TRUE,
            perl = TRUE
        )
        if (length(m) == 0) {
            return(NULL)
        }
        sub(sprintf("^\\s*%s:\\s*", field), "", m[1], perl = TRUE)
    }

    lines <- content[(dashes[1] + 1):(dashes[2] - 1)]

    name <- get_yaml_field(lines, "name")
    desc <- get_yaml_field(lines, "description")
    version <- get_yaml_field(lines, "version")
    trigger <- get_yaml_field(lines, "trigger")

    if (is.null(name)) {
        next
    }

    m <- get_playbook_meta(name)

    playbooks[[length(playbooks) + 1]] <- list(
        name = name,
        desc = desc %||% "",
        version = version %||% "1.0.0",
        trigger = trigger %||% "manual",
        dir = basename(dir),
        icon = m[1],
        category = m[2],
        gh_url = sprintf(
            "https://github.com/davidrsch/r-playbooks/blob/main/playbooks/%s/PLAYBOOK.md",
            basename(dir)
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
n_total <- length(playbooks)
cats <- sort(table(sapply(playbooks, `[[`, "category")), decreasing = TRUE)
init_show <- 12
```

::: {.playbook-grid id="playbook-grid"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cards <- character(length(playbooks))
for (i in seq_along(playbooks)) {
    pb <- playbooks[[i]]
    trigger_class <- if (pb$trigger == "both") "both" else "manual"
    trigger_label <- toupper(pb$trigger)
    hidden_style <- if (i > init_show) ";display:none" else ""

    cat(paste0(
        '<div class="playbook-card" data-name="',
        pb$name,
        '" data-category="',
        pb$category,
        '" style="--card-accent: var(--bs-primary)',
        hidden_style,
        '">',
        '<label class="card-check"><input type="checkbox" class="card-checkbox" data-file="',
        pb$dir,
        '" data-name="',
        pb$name,
        '" title="Select this playbook"></label>',
        '<a href="',
        pb$gh_url,
        '" class="card-body">',
        '<div class="card-header"><span class="card-icon">',
        pb$icon,
        '</span><span class="card-name">',
        pb$name,
        "</span></div>",
        '<div class="card-description">',
        pb$desc,
        "</div>",
        '<span class="badge badge-category">',
        pb$category,
        "</span>",
        '<div class="card-meta"><span class="badge badge-version">v',
        pb$version,
        '</span><span class="badge badge-trigger ',
        trigger_class,
        '">',
        trigger_label,
        '</span><span class="badge badge-link">📋 source</span></div>',
        "</a>",
        "</div>",
        "\n"
    ))
}
```
